model.name: SoulX-Singer
model.description: Zero-shot singing voice synthesis. Clones a singer's timbre from a short reference vocal and re-sings a target song (lyrics and melody are transcribed from the target audio). This recipe wraps the original Space's existing pipeline (preprocessing + SVS) instead of reimplementing it, so it must be deployed into a duplicate of the Soul-AILab/SoulX-Singer Space, where the webui module and pretrained weights are present.
model.author: Soul-AILab

inputs.name: prompt_audio
inputs.label: Prompt audio (reference voice, <=30s)
inputs.info: Short clip of the singer whose timbre you want to clone (max 30s).

inputs.name: target_audio
inputs.label: Target audio (song / melody source, <=60s)
inputs.info: The song to re-sing; its lyrics and melody are transcribed automatically (max 60s).

inputs.name: control
inputs.label: Control type
inputs.info: melody = follow the target's F0 contour; score = follow transcribed MIDI notes.

inputs.name: prompt_lyric_lang
inputs.label: Prompt lyric language
inputs.info: Language of the reference vocal (selects the matching lyric transcriber).

inputs.name: target_lyric_lang
inputs.label: Target lyric language
inputs.info: Language of the target song. Must match the song or the words come out garbled.

inputs.name: prompt_vocal_sep
inputs.label: Prompt vocal separation
inputs.info: Separate vocals from the reference clip first. Leave off for a clean a cappella prompt.

inputs.name: target_vocal_sep
inputs.label: Target vocal separation
inputs.info: Separate vocals from the target song before transcription (recommended for full mixes).

inputs.name: auto_shift
inputs.label: Auto pitch shift
inputs.info: Automatically shift pitch to fit the reference singer's range.

inputs.name: pitch_shift
inputs.label: Pitch shift (semitones)
inputs.info: Manual pitch shift applied when auto pitch shift is off.

inference.setup:
import os

# Headless matplotlib backend, mirroring the original Space's app.py.
os.environ.setdefault("MPLBACKEND", "Agg")

# Importing the Space's own module downloads the pretrained weights and builds
# the SVS + preprocessing pipeline exactly as the original SoulX-Singer app does.
# (synthesis_function already carries its own Spaces GPU decorator.)
from webui import synthesis_function
inference.body:
merged, _prompt_meta, _target_meta = synthesis_function(
    prompt_audio,
    target_audio,
    prompt_metadata=None,
    target_metadata=None,
    control=control,
    auto_shift=auto_shift,
    pitch_shift=int(pitch_shift),
    prompt_lyric_lang=prompt_lyric_lang,
    target_lyric_lang=target_lyric_lang,
    prompt_vocal_sep=prompt_vocal_sep,
    target_vocal_sep=target_vocal_sep,
)
if not merged:
    raise gr.Error("Synthesis failed - check the Space logs for the backend error.")
return merged
